rationale: BSA [[page 10]] s.1(2): 'It applies to all judicial proceedings in or before any Court, including Courts-martial, but not to affidavits ... nor to proceedings before an arbitrator'; s.1(3) fn: in force 1-7-2024 vide S.O. 849(E) dated 23-2-2024. [[page 51]] s.170(1) repeals the IEA; s.170(2) keeps the IEA for any application, trial, inquiry, investigation, proceeding or appeal pending immediately before commencement. These enacted provisions are material inputs to the transition question the record raises; their omission risks treating the issue as wholly open.
